Pinion Tanaka is a character in Cars 2. He is a gold-painted micro van and a professional Sumo wrestler from Tokyo, Japan, who’s always a menacing sight in the ring in his signature teal mawashi.

Who is Pinion Tanaka?

Pinion Tanaka is a character in Cars 2. He is a gold-painted micro van and a professional Sumo wrestler from Tokyo, Japan, who’s always a menacing sight in the ring in his signature teal mawashi.
